title: Astronomy Picture of the Day
description: A new astronomical image or photograph every day, with explanation by a professional astronomer. Running since 1995 — the most-loved NASA service.
concepts: astronomy picture of the day daily image nebula galaxy space photo
sampleResponse:
{
  "date": "2026-11-01",
  "title": "Andromeda Over the Alps",
  "explanation": "A bright spiral galaxy…",
  "media_type": "image",
  "url": "https://apod.nasa.gov/…jpg",
  "service_version": "v1"
}
long: The Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) by NASA & MTU. Daily image + scientist-written explanation. API supports single date, date range (start_date/end_date), count, or thumbs.

title: Near Earth Object Web Service (NeoWs)
description: Track every asteroid passing near Earth. Feed of close approaches with size, velocity, miss distance & hazard flag. Critical for planetary defense.
concepts: asteroid near earth objects planetary defense orbit close approach
long: NeoWs feeds NASA JPL Center for Near-Earth Object Studies (CNEOS). Includes asteroid lookup by ID, browse & close-approach feed. Hazard flag = potentially hazardous asteroid (PHA).

title: Mars Rover Photos
description: Searchable photos from Curiosity, Perseverance, Spirit & Opportunity rovers. Filter by sol, camera, Earth date & rover.
concepts: mars rover photos sol camera curiosity perseverance
long: Mars Photo API for all NASA rovers. Also rovers manifest endpoint gives landing date, status & photo counts per sol.

title: Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera (EPIC)
description: Full-disc Earth imagery from DSCOVR at L1, roughly 1.5M km away — the “pale blue dot” in near-real-time.
concepts: earth polychromatic imaging camera dscovr full disc
long: EPIC on NOAA/NASA DSCOVR — 10-band camera imaging the sunlit side of Earth ~1.5 million km away. Archive back to 2015.

title: NASA Exoplanet Archive
description: Over 5,000+ confirmed planets beyond our solar system. Search by distance, size, period, temperature, host star. Tap-synced SQL API.
concepts: exoplanet archive confirmed planets habitable zone
sampleRequest: SELECT pl_name, pl_eqt, pl_orbsdep, pl_rade FROM ps WHERE pl_rade > 1 ORDER BY pl_orbsdep DESC
long: Caltech/IPAC archive for NASA. TAP/ADQL + REST. Includes confirmed planets, TOIs (Kepler/TESS candidates), spectra, light curves.

title: NASA Image & Video Library
description: Hundreds of thousands of NASA photos, videos & audio across missions. Full metadata, collections API, CC-BY.
concepts: nasa images video library archive media
long: images.nasa.gov — powerful search API with collections, assets, captions. Powers NASA Image of the Day, mission galleries & Wikipedia.

title: Fire Information for Resource Management System
description: Near-real-time global fire detection & thermal anomalies from MODIS/VIIRS. Used for wildfires, deforestation, air quality.
concepts: fire information resource management thermal anomaly
long: FIRMS — LANCE/EOSDIS. CSV/JSON/SHAPEFILE. ~375m–1km resolution, near-real-time (<3h). Essential for disaster & climate apps.

title: Space Weather Database (DONKI)
description: Coronal mass ejections, solar flares, geomagnetic storms, SEP & shock data from CCMC. Forecast & historical.
concepts: space weather donki coronal mass ejection solar flare
long: DONKI = Database Of Notifications, Knowledge and Information. Flare, CME, ISS, SEP, IMAP, notifications, HST, RPG, RBE endpoints.

title: Artemis Program Data
description: Artemis I/II/III mission data: trajectories, Orion, lunar Gateway, suits, ground systems & science.
concepts: artemis program orion lunar gateway moon
long: Artemis is NASA's lunar return program. Portal links mission pages, trajectory maps, EVA data (via PDS), & NTRS reports.

title: Landsat Science
description: 50+ years of 30m multispectral Earth imagery (Landsat 1–9). Agriculture, land cover, climate change.
sampleResponse: exports: GeoTIFF, browse JPG, scene metadata
long: USGS/NASA Landsat — longest-running Earth-observation (1972→). Open data via USGS EROS / EarthExplorer.

title: Exoplanet Watch & TESS
description: TESS & Kepler transit candidates, TOIs, and citizen-science follow-up observations.

title: Planetary Data System (PDS)
description: Archival data for all NASA planetary missions — geometry, labels, bundles, NASA PDS Atlas.
sampleRequest: GET pds.nasa.gov — search by mission / instrument / target
long: PDS is the NASA archive standard (since 1989). Data volumes, SPICE kernels, raw + calibrated products.

title: GES DISC Earth Science Data
description: Atmosphere, hydrology, cryosphere, ocean color, precipitation & more. OPeNDAP + subsets (AURA, MERRA, TRMM/GPM).
concepts: ges disc earth science atmosphere ocean
sampleResponse: subset: variable, region, time → NetCDF / CSV
long: Goddard Earth Sciences Data & Information Services Center. Huge NetCDF/HDF archives with OPeNDAP access.

title: NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS)
description: NASA research papers, reports, patents & presentations. Full-text search, STI Repository.
long: NTRS — NASA STI Repository. 400k+ docs, citation + download counts, filters by center/year/subject.

title: NASA Climate Data & Portal
description: Climate indicators, GISTEMP, sea level, carbon cycle & visualizations.
long: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS) + Goddard Institute. Global climate indicators updated monthly.

title: JPL Horizons & Small-Body Database
description: Precise ephemeris for planets, asteroids, comets & spacecraft. SPICE kernels.
long: JPL Small-Body Database + Horizons — gold standard for asteroid/comet orbits, close approaches & ephemeris.

title: Hubble Space Telescope Archive
description: Hubble science & public imagery (ESA/Hubble), Mikulski Archive (MAST) — spectra, images, light curves.
long: ESA/Hubble + STScI MAST. Public data after proprietary period. HSTView, browse images.

title: Gaia Mission — Star Catalog
description: Billion-star catalog: positions, parallaxes, proper motions, photometry. 1.8B+ sources (DR3).
sampleRequest: SELECT TOP 10 source_id, ra, dec, parallax FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
long: ESA Gaia — precise 3D map of the Milky Way. ADQL/TAP + CSV/VOTable. DR3/DR4 releases.

title: Copernicus Earth Observation (Sentinels)
description: Sentinel-1/2/3/5P open Earth data: land, ocean, atmosphere, emergencies (EMS). 10m Sentinel-2.
long: EU Copernicus — free & open Earth data. SciHub + Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE) API.

title: James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)
description: Webb public imagery, science data via MAST, STScI. Infrared deep-field data.
concepts: webb space telescope jwst infrared deep field
long: ESA/NASA/CSA Webb. Science data public after 12-month proprietary (MAST). Public images immediate.

title: Euclid Dark Universe Survey
description: Euclid wide-field visible/NIR survey — dark matter, dark energy, galaxy morphology.
long: ESA Euclid (2023→). Public releases include images, spectra, catalogs.

title: JAXA Earth Observation (EORC/G-Portal)
description: ALOS, GCOM, Himawari, GOSAT, Earth-observation open data & quicklooks.
long: JAXA Earth Observation Research Center (EORC). G-Portal + JAXA Earth data portal.

title: Himawari-8/9 Weather Imagery
description: High-cadence full-disc Asia-Pacific weather imagery (2.5-min RAPID sector).
sampleResponse:
image: full-disc PNG/JPEG
+ Himawari User's Guide
long: JMA/JAXA Himawari — geostationary weather satellite over Asia-Pacific. Himawari Standard Data.

title: Bhuvan — ISRO Geoportal
description: ISRO Bhuvan — Indian remote-sensing geoportal: Bhuvan, Bhoosat, thematic maps, APIs.
long: Bhuvan (NRSC) — India's geoportal, 10m–50m imagery, 3D views, thematic maps.

title: MOSDAC — ISRO Weather & Ocean
description: INSAT-3D/3DR weather, OCEANSAT ocean color, scatterometer wind, CYGNSS.
long: Meteorological & Oceanic Satellite Data Archival Centre — INSAT/OCEANSAT products.

title: RADARSAT & Canadian Space Data
description: RADARSAT-2/RCM SAR data, satellite imagery, Arctic & maritime monitoring.
long: Canadian Space Agency — RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM) — SAR for Arctic, oceans & disaster.

title: CNSA Open Data (China)
description: GF, HJ, ZY Earth satellites, Chang'e lunar, Tianwen Mars — limited public catalogs.
concepts: cnsa china lunar mars chang e
long: CNSA public data policy is selective; Chang'e lunar science & GF Earth data via CEDA/China GEOSS.

title: ASI COSMO-SkyMed & Italian Data
description: COSMO-SkyMed SAR, PRISMA hyperspectral, AGILE gamma-ray.
long: Italian Space Agency (ASI) + e-Geos (ASI/Telespazio) — COSMO-SkyMed SAR open data.

title: DLR TanDEM-X & TerraSAR-X
description: TanDEM-X global DEM (12m), TerraSAR-X SAR, ENMAP hyperspectral, DLR Earth data.
long: German Aerospace Center (DLR) Earth Observation Center — open DEM & SAR since 2015.

title: EUMETSAT Weather Satellites
description: Meteosat, Metop, Sentinel-3/4/5/6 weather & climate data, EUMETSAT Data Centre.
long: European weather satellite organisation — MSG/MTG, Metop, Sentinel synergy.

title: KARI — Korea Aerospace Data
description: KOMPSAT, DANURI lunar orbiter, KPLO, KARI open data.
long: Korea Aerospace Research Institute — KOMPSAT geoportal + DANURI lunar science (from 2023).

title: SPICE Kernels & Navigation
description: SPICE ephemeris, SCLK, FK, leapseconds — spacecraft & planet positions.
long: NAIF SPICE — planetary & spacecraft ephemeris files (bsp, bc). CSPICE/CSPICE tools.

title: Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO)
description: SDO/AIA solar imagery in 10 wavelengths — daily sun movies, flare watching.
long: SDO (2010→) — ultra-high cadence solar imaging. SDO Data Portal + JSOC.

title: ISS Telemetry & Tracking
description: ISS position, crew, experiments, HDEV earth video, spot-the-station passes.
long: ISS live position (Whence the ISS at / JPL), crew manifest (HowDidiDo), HDEV video, SpotTheStation predictions.

title: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)
description: LRO global lunar maps: LOLA topography, LROC mosaics, Diviner temps. PDS Geosciences Node.
long: LRO (2009→) — high-res Moon atlas via ASU (LROC) & PDS. Lunar QuickMap.

title: Ocean Color & Sea Surface (MODIS)
description: Ocean color (chlorophyll), SST, PAR, winds — SeaWiFS/MODIS/VIIRS ocean products.
long: Ocean Biology Processing Group (OBPG) — ocean color since 1997. Crucial for climate & fisheries.

title: ICESat-2 Ice & Elevation
description: Laser altimetry: ice sheets, sea ice, forest heights, topography. ATL06/08 products.
long: ICESat-2 (2018→) — photon-counting lidar. NSIDC/ORNL DAAC. Ice-sheet mass balance.

title: GRACE-FO Gravity & Water
description: Gravity field changes → groundwater, ocean mass, ice melt. GRACE-FO monthly solutions.
long: GRACE/GRACE-FO (2002→) — twin-satellite gravimetry. NASA JPL + GFZ Potsdam.

title: NASA Earthdata — All Earth Science
description: Single gateway to 30+ Earth-science DAACs: MODIS, ASTER, OCO-2, GPM, SMAP, SWOT…
long: Earthdata (EOSDIS) — CMR concept API + Harmony + LAADS. 2B+ granules. Login required for downloads (free).

title: NASA Air Quality & TEMPO
description: TEMPO (North America), TROPOMI air quality, NO2, O3, aerosols, fire smoke.
long: TEMPO + OCO-2/3 CO2. Air-quality forecasts & hourly maps.

title: NASA Biological & Physical Sciences
description: Life & physical sciences experiments on ISS — gene expression, plants, materials.
long: Space Biology & Physical Sciences portfolio. Data via NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR).

title: Planck CMB — Cosmic Microwave Background
description: All-sky CMB temperature & polarization maps (Planck 2018 legacy).
long: ESA Planck (2009–2013). Legacy maps in ESOC archive. Cosmology gold mine.

title: Parker Solar Probe
description: Closest approach to the Sun — corona, solar wind, magnetic fields. FIELDS, WISPR, SWEAP.
long: Parker (2018→) — 24 encounters. Solar Orbiter complementary (ESA).

title: MESSENGER Mercury Atlas
description: Mercury global maps: MDIS, MASCS, topography. PDS Geosciences.
long: MESSENGER (2004–2015) Mercury global survey. JHUAPL/PDS.

title: Juno Jupiter Science
description: Jupiter gravity, magnetosphere, aurora, microwave sounding. PDS/PDS4 + MAST?
long: Juno (2011→) polar orbits of Jupiter. SwRI PI.

title: Cassini Saturn System
description: Saturn, rings, Titan, Enceladus — images, spectra, magnetosphere. PDS Small Bodies/Outer Planets.
long: Cassini-Huygens (1997–2017) — 13-year Saturn tour. Legacy archive.

title: New Horizons Pluto & KBO
description: Pluto flyby + Kuiper Belt objects (Arrokoth). LORRI, Ralph, Alice.
long: New Horizons (2006→) — Pluto 2015, Arrokoth 2019, ongoing KBO flybys.

title: OSIRIS-REx Asteroid Bennu
description: Bennu asteroid sample return, maps, spectroscopy, OTES. PDS Small Bodies Node.
long: OSIRIS-REx (2016–2023) — Bennu samples returned Sep 2023, now curated at JSC.

title: Psyche Metal Asteroid
description: Metal asteroid Psyche core investigation — multispectral imager, GRF, magnetometer.
long: Psyche (2023→) — first metal world visit. ASU PI.

title: Lucy Trojan Asteroids
description: Jupiter Trojan asteroids — 8 targets, L’TES, LORRI, E-THERM.
long: Lucy (2021→) — first Trojan mission. SwRI PI.

title: DART Planetary Defense
description: Dimorphos kinetic impact — orbit change, ejecta, LICCIACube images.
long: DART (2021–2022) — first asteroid deflection. Heliophysics? Planetary Defense.

title: Europa Clipper
description: Europa ocean world — EIS, REASON, MASPEX. Launch 2024, arrival 2030.
long: Europa Clipper (2024→) — JPL. 49 flybys.

title: Horizons API (JPL)
description: Machine-readable ephemeris for any body/spacecraft — vectors, elements, small-body.
long: Horizons — scriptable JPL ephemeris. Browser + API. Essential for mission design.

title: Solar Orbiter (ESA/NASA)
description: Close Sun views, polar views, in-situ + remote sensing. EUI, SoloHI, in-situ suite.
long: Solar Orbiter (2020→) — ESA PI, NASA contribution.

title: SWOT Ocean & Water (NASA/CNES)
description: KaRIn radar — sea-surface height, rivers, lakes, inland water.
long: SWOT (2022→) — NASA/CNES. First 2D water topography. PO.DAAC + CNES.

title: Global Precipitation Mission (GPM)
description: Rain, snow, cyclones — DPR/GMI merged products, IMERG.
long: GPM (2014→) — NASA/JAXA. IMERG global 30-min precipitation.

title: Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP)
description: Global soil moisture, freeze/thaw. L-band radiometer/radar.
long: SMAP (2015→) — 9km soil moisture, 3-day revisit. NSIDC DAAC.

title: Ocean Data View / PO.DAAC
description: Sea-surface height, currents, winds, SST — PO.DAAC merged products.
long: Physical Oceanography DAAC — altimetry, scatterometry, SAR.

title: NASA CubeSat & SmallSat Data
description: CubeSat science returns, rideshare, technology demos.
long: SmallSat Institute + SMD CubeSats.

title: NASA Missions & Spacecraft
description: Mission pages, spacecraft status, trajectories, media — unified mission graph.
long: science.nasa.gov — mission finder, spacecraft pages, latest news.

title: Astronauts & People in Space
description: Crew rosters, EVAs, astronaut bios, historical missions.
long: NASA Astronaut Office + ESA/Roscosmos crew data exchanges (WhereNow).

title: Cluster & Magnetosphere (ESA)
description: Four-spacecraft magnetospheric constellation.
long: Cluster II (2000–2024) — tetrahedron magnetospheric. CDAWeb/NASA.
